Name: (AT)Song Ke's Mid-Autumn Festival Laurel
Author: CiChangAn
Description:
[b][size=3][color=#f6b26b]* 介绍 *[/color]
*introduce *[/size]
[/b]
[color=#f6b26b]这是送客的粉丝福利（中秋桂树），替代了游戏里的小屋，有两种朝向可选[/color]
This is a special gift for Song Ke's fans (Mid-Autumn Festival Osmanthus Tree), replacing the shed in the game. It is available in two orientations.

[color=#f6b26b]大家下载前请务必阅读使用说明。[/color]
Please read the instructions before downloading.
————————————————————————————————————
[b][size=3]
[color=#93c47d]* 使用方式 *[/color]
* How to use *[/size][/b]

[color=#93c47d]确保下载了 [b]SMAPI[/b]  和 [b]Alternative Textures[/b]。[/color]
Make sure to download [b]SMAPI [/b]and [b]Alternative Textures[/b].

[color=#93c47d]下载mod，将文件解压后放入mod文件夹里。[/color]
Download the mod, unzip the files and put them in the mod folder.

[color=#93c47d]进入游戏后，前往木匠罗宾处购买油漆桶，左键对房屋使用即可。[/color]
After entering the game, find Robin the carpenter to buy a paint bucket, left click on the house to use.
